title: PackageGuard configuration
description: The policy that PackageGuard checks your NuGet and npm dependencies against. See https://packageguard.org/configuration

$schema.description: The JSON schema that describes this file.

settings.description: The allow, deny and warn rules, the risk and vulnerability exceptions, and the feeds to ignore.

allow.description: Packages, licenses and feeds that are allowed. When this section lists licenses or packages, everything else is a violation.

packages.description: Packages that are always allowed, whatever their license. Supports the wildcards * and ?, and an optional NuGet version (range) after a /, such as "MyPackage/[7.0.0,8.0.0)".

licenses.description: SPDX license identifiers or expressions that are allowed, such as "MIT" or "Apache-2.0". Not case-sensitive.

feeds.description: Wildcard patterns that match the name or URL of a feed. Every package from a matching feed is allowed.

prerelease.description: Whether pre-release versions, such as 1.0.2-beta.2, are allowed.

deny.description: Packages and licenses that are denied, and the risk gates. A deny rule always takes precedence over an allow rule.

packages.description: Packages that are denied. Supports the wildcards * and ?, and an optional NuGet version (range) after a /, such as "MyPackage/[7.0.0,8.0.0)".

licenses.description: SPDX license identifiers or expressions that are denied. Not case-sensitive.

prerelease.description: Whether to deny all pre-release versions, such as 1.0.2-beta.2.

maxOverallRisk.description: Denies a package whose overall risk score (0-100) is higher than this value.

maxLegalRisk.description: Denies a package whose legal risk score (0-10) is higher than this value.

maxSecurityRisk.description: Denies a package whose security risk score (0-10) is higher than this value.

maxOperationalRisk.description: Denies a package whose operational risk score (0-10) is higher than this value.

maxOsvSeverityScore.description: Denies a package whose highest known OSV vulnerability severity (CVSS score, 0-10) is higher than this value. For example, 7.0 denies anything rated High or above.

denyKnownExploited.description: Denies a package that has a vulnerability on the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) list.

denyUnsigned.description: Denies packages that aren't signed. Packages for which signing can't be checked, such as npm packages, are never denied by this rule.

denyDeprecated.description: Denies packages that their registry marks as deprecated.

denyWithoutRepository.description: Denies packages that don't declare a repository URL.

minPackageAgeDays.description: Denies a package version published fewer than the given number of days ago, per ecosystem.

npm.description: The minimum age in days of an npm package version.

nuget.description: The minimum age in days of a NuGet package version.

warn.description: Packages and licenses that are reported as a warning instead of failing the build. A deny rule takes precedence over a warn rule.

packages.description: Packages that cause a warning. Supports the wildcards * and ?, and an optional NuGet version (range) after a /, such as "MyPackage/[7.0.0,8.0.0)".

licenses.description: SPDX license identifiers or expressions that cause a warning. Not case-sensitive.

prerelease.description: Whether to warn about pre-release versions, such as 1.0.2-beta.2.

riskExceptions.description: Packages that are excluded from the risk-based deny rules. They have no effect on the package and license rules.

package.description: The name of the package, or a wildcard pattern.

versions.description: An optional NuGet version or version range, such as "[1.0.0,2.0.0)". Without it, the exception applies to every version.

reason.description: Why the risk of this package is accepted.

expiresOn.description: An optional date (yyyy-MM-dd) after which the exception no longer applies.

vulnerabilityExceptions.description: Vulnerabilities that you analyzed and decided do not apply to you.

vulnerability.description: The OSV identifier of the vulnerability, or any of its aliases, such as a CVE- or GHSA- ID.

package.description: An optional package name or wildcard pattern to limit the exception to. Defaults to every package.

reason.description: Why the vulnerability does not apply to you.

reviewOn.description: The date (yyyy-MM-dd) on which to review the decision again. After this date, the vulnerability counts again.

ignoredFeeds.description: The names or URLs of NuGet feeds that PackageGuard should never access.
